scope: Use existing Run 1, Run 2, and B1 outcome branches to characterize whether transition behavior exhibits common, separable, and/or interface-conditioned structure. No new model generation and no construct validation.

block_construction.Q_N: neutral correct count / neutral revision count when neutral revision count > 0; otherwise missing by definition
block_construction.T_instability: 1 iff the two neutral final answers disagree; otherwise 0

analysis.pairwise_metric: Spearman rho across complete blocks for each primary-dimension pair within each interface stratum
analysis.directional_pair_cell: 95% bootstrap interval for Spearman rho lies strictly above or below zero, using at least 4000 valid non-degenerate bootstrap draws
analysis.replicated_directional_edge: same directional sign for a dimension pair in at least two independent historical strata, each meeting both the minimum complete-block and minimum valid-bootstrap rules
analysis.conflicting_directional_edge: a dimension pair has directional cells of opposite signs in different usable strata
analysis.weak_coupling_cell: 95% bootstrap interval for Spearman rho lies entirely inside [-0.15,+0.15], using at least 4000 valid non-degenerate bootstrap draws
analysis.replicated_weak_coupling_edge: same dimension pair satisfies the weak-coupling cell rule in at least two independent historical strata, each meeting both pairwise admissibility rules
analysis.Q_N_profile_estimator: pooled neutral correct transitions / pooled neutral revisions within stratum
analysis.profile_bootstrap: whole-block bootstrap; Q_N bootstrap draw is valid only when at least one revised neutral branch is present
analysis.legacy_agreement_dimension: absolute RUN1-RUN2 point difference <= 0.05 and the 95% bootstrap interval for RUN1-RUN2 includes zero
analysis.B1_divergence_dimension: B1-RUN1 and B1-RUN2 point differences both have absolute magnitude >= 0.05, both 95% bootstrap intervals exclude zero, and both differences have the same sign
analysis.interface_conditioned_dimension: legacy_agreement_dimension and B1_divergence_dimension are both true

representation_gates.H_T1_COMMON_STRUCTURE_SIGNAL: Build an undirected graph over the four primary dimensions using replicated directional edges. Signal true iff the graph is connected and there are no conflicting directional edges among usable cells.
representation_gates.H_T2_SEPARABLE_STRUCTURE_SIGNAL: Signal true iff at least two distinct replicated weak-coupling edges exist and together involve at least three of the four primary dimensions. This indicates practically weak monotonic coupling, not statistical independence or a psychological multidimensional construct.
representation_gates.H_T3_INTERFACE_CONDITIONED_SIGNAL: Signal true iff at least two primary profile dimensions satisfy the frozen interface-conditioned-dimension rule. This is evidence of interface-family-associated profile change, not causal attribution to interface because cohorts differ.

summary_state.MIXED_STRUCTURE: two or more representation signals are true

interpretation_guardrails: C1 and C2 are not treated as exchangeable independent indicators; Q_N conditions on revision and C2 is otherwise derived descriptive output only.
No factor analysis, PCA, latent-variable model, composite correction score, or new moderator is permitted in A2-D.
A nonsignificant association does not count as separability; only the frozen practical weak-coupling interval rule does.
Rare-event or degenerate bootstrap cells with fewer than 4000 valid resamples cannot create directional or weak-coupling topology edges.
A common-structure signal means a common ordering remains empirically plausible; it does not establish a unitary latent trait.
A separable-structure signal means collapsing dimensions would likely lose monotonic information; it does not establish a psychological multidimensional construct.
An interface-conditioned signal is historical association with interface family, not a randomized causal interface effect.
G_verified_minus_neutral is descriptive/causal only within its frozen randomized interface and is excluded from representation gates to avoid double-counting.
No A2-D result updates B, C, H1, I1, S, or CARS and A1-V remains uncreated.
